description: ReactDOM.render() is removed — replace with createRoot().render()
ReactDOM.hydrate() is removed — replace with hydrateRoot()
react-dom/test-utils act() is deprecated — use act() from 'react' directly
Automatic batching: setState calls in timeouts/promises are now batched — may affect tests relying on intermediate renders
manualAction: Review any tests that assert on intermediate render states inside setTimeout, Promise.then, or native event handlers. Wrap those assertions in `act()` or use `flushSync` from 'react-dom' to opt out of automatic batching where needed.

description: ReactDOM.render no longer supports callbacks as a third argument
manualAction: Search for ReactDOM.render calls with a third callback argument. Move the callback logic into the rendered component (e.g. a useEffect) or use the Promise-based API available through createRoot.

description: Strict Mode now double-invokes effects in development to help detect side effects
manualAction: Audit useEffect, useLayoutEffect, and class lifecycle methods for non-idempotent side effects (network requests, analytics calls, subscriptions). Ensure cleanup functions are implemented so double-invocation does not cause observable problems in development.

description: ReactDOM.unstable_batchedUpdates behaviour changed with concurrent rendering
manualAction: With React 18's automatic batching, explicit calls to unstable_batchedUpdates are no longer needed in most cases. Remove them and verify behaviour. If you need to force synchronous rendering, use flushSync from 'react-dom' instead.
